title: Domain Profile
description: Pluggable per-project domain profile. ALL domain-specific invariants live HERE, never hardcoded in the control plane or agents. The system is AI/CS-research-general; a profile specializes it (cv-medical-segmentation, nlp-text-classification, rl, tabular, speech, ...). Director lock: medical imaging is just one profile, not the target.

default_split_unit.description: e.g. patient, document, episode, user, graph, sample

forbidden_split_units.description: units that would cause leakage, e.g. slice/patch for medical volumes, token for text

leakage_checks.description: named checks the split / alignment auditors must run

implementation_ref.description: canonical metric implementation, so all conditions compute it identically

valid_range.description: [min, max] sanity bounds (either end null = unbounded); result-sanity-checker BLOCKs a value outside this. null = no declared range (range check skipped for this metric).

leakage_delta.description: result-sanity-checker leakage-smell threshold: an improvement over baseline >= this (direction per higher_is_better) is implausibly good and BLOCKs. Domain-tunable; default 0.5.

alignment_invariants.description: extra train/test/inference parity checks specific to this domain (consumed by train-test-alignment-auditor)

protocol_fields.description: free-form domain protocol params (e.g. interactive-prompt config for seg, tokenization for NLP); structure is domain-defined

hard_invariants.description: non-negotiable rules the gates enforce for this domain
